crs.input_georeference: fitted printed graticule (12 meridians, 10 parallels); the PDF has no /VP, /LGIDict or /Measure object and no projection statement
crs.note: No CRS object is embedded.  The graticule fit is the georeference; its values are treated as WGS84 degrees.  If the printed graticule was on the Minna datum (Clarke 1880), the WGS84 difference is ~0.1-0.2 km, below the ~1 km accuracy of the sheet.

features: coastline / sea edge (raster of the map sheet)

model.note: dlat = (A + B*(lat-lat0)) / km_per_deg degrees, north positive; dlon = 0

notes: The 2011 geological sheet agrees with Natural Earth to ~1 km
(border +0.1/-0.0 km, coastline -0.4 km): no correction applied.

topographic_overlay.note: The sheets' topographic overlay (towns, roads, railway, capital squares) was plotted with a ~0.66 % scale error relative to the graticule.  This model measures that displacement; it is NOT applied to the layers. Corrected town coordinates are in towns_true_wgs84.csv.  See ACCURACY.md section 4.3.
